normalization_rules.manifest_self_hash: Canonical compact JSON after replacing the manifest self digest, report digest, and corpus_package_boundary_hash with 64 ASCII zeroes.
normalization_rules.report_package_hash: SHA-256 after replacing the value on the corpus_package_boundary_hash line with 64 ASCII zeroes.
normalization_rules.package_membership: Every manifest entry whose role is not AUDIT_HISTORY.
